top_signals.title: Finland closes airspace, restricts maritime traffic near Russia over drone risk
top_signals.summary: Finland’s military said it closed a section of Finnish airspace and restricted maritime traffic off the country’s southern coast near the Russian border.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ionic Digital jumps 25% in Nasdaq debut after expanding Celsius bitcoin mining assets into AI infrastructure
top_signals.summary: Ionic Digital was formed from Celsius Mining’s assets and later took direct control of its sites from Hut 8.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Tech stocks extend sell-off with SoftBank down 10% as AI plays take a hit
top_signals.summary: Chinese internet stocks listed in Hong Kong bucked the broader regional weakness with Tencent, Meituan, Baidu and Kuaishou all trading higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Coalition of 44 state attorneys general says CFTC lacks authority over sports prediction markets
top_signals.summary: The group of AGs sent a letter to the CFTC, urging the agency to draft new rules consistent with the Commodity Exchange Act.
